title: Frontend: Stock analysis page (signal, confidence, screens)
description: UI for GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis — the Triple Screen signal, confidence score/breakdown, and per-screen detail for one ticker. Chart integration is a separate task (frontend-stock-history-chart) since it's a distinct backend endpoint with its own loading/error lifecycle.

checklist.step: A ticker entry point (search box navigating to /stocks/:ticker) — decide and record where this lives (e.g. in AppShell's top bar vs. a dedicated field on this page); either is reasonable, but don't build both.

features/stocks/components/SignalSummary.tsx: common/SignalBadge for the signal, common/ConfidenceGauge for confidence/confidence_band, and a breakdown table of confidence_breakdown (component, weight, score) per Analyse.md §6.

features/stocks/components/ScreensPanel.tsx: structured display of screens.tide (trend, weekly_macd_histogram_slope), screens.impulse, screens.wave (stochastic_k, force_index_2ema, state), screens.trigger (fired, reference) — readable labels, not a raw JSON dump.
features/stocks/components/IndicatorsPanel.tsx: the latest ema_13/ema_26/macd_histogram/bull_power/bear_power values as a small stat grid — explicitly not a chart overlay, per Frontend.md §5.
pages/StockDetailPage.tsx composes the ticker input (if placed here), SignalSummary, ScreensPanel, IndicatorsPanel — stays thin.

Component tests (MSW-mocked) for: BUY/SELL/HOLD happy paths, and every documented error case for this endpoint from API.md (404 unknown ticker, 422 insufficient history, 503 provider unavailable) surfaced via common/ErrorState with the right message per case.

decisions.decision: Note for whoever works this task: the checklist's first item (a ticker entry point) already has an implementation to reuse — `frontend/src/features/stocks/components/TickerSearchBox.tsx`, built by frontend-dashboard-page (which needed a ticker lookup and couldn't wait on this task). It navigates to `/stocks/:ticker` via `useNavigate` and is currently rendered from DashboardPage's PageHeader action.
decisions.rationale: frontend-dashboard-page's checklist explicitly called for reusing this task's entry point 'if that task placed it on a page rather than in AppShell' — but this task hadn't been started yet when frontend-dashboard-page ran, so there was nothing to reuse and it had to build one itself instead. Recording this here so this task reuses TickerSearchBox (e.g. also rendering it on StockDetailPage, or leaving it dashboard-only if a second entry point isn't wanted) rather than building a second, near-duplicate ticker search box — see Frontend.md §3's near-duplicate consolidation rule and this task's own checklist item 1, which still needs an explicit decision recorded here once resolved.
